**The problem / job-seeker pain**
What are you trying to do? Who does it help (e.g., laid-off engineers, visa-constrained seekers)?

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like Rebound to do. If it maps to a roadmap item, link it (`roadmap/`).

**Which area**
- [ ] Resume tailoring
- [ ] Role discovery / matching (`/rebound:match`)
- [ ] Moral support / momentum (`/rebound:rise`)
- [ ] Profile / situation handling
- [ ] Export (docx/pdf)
- [ ] Other

**Honesty & privacy check**
Does this keep the core principles intact (no fabrication; situation data stays local)? Note any concerns.

**Alternatives considered**
Anything you already tried or ruled out.
